label: run99 availability
definition: Run 99: MEASURED PROBE - availability double-count test on the run-97a keeper base. --wefor-residual 0 zeros the statistical forced-outage WEFOR for the CAMPD-covered classes (coal + CC_REGULAR/CC_CHP/ST_GAS/ST_CHP, the _POF_DROP_GROUPS); coal_drop_pof already drops their planned POF. Keeps the summer ambient capacity derate, per-plant coal max-CF ceilings, and ALL measured CAMPD layers (historic >10d overlay + unit-outage derate + partial-outage derate). Tests the user hypothesis that stacking statistical WEFOR/POF on top of the measured CAMPD outages double-counts unavailability and caps CC below its real summer ceiling (0.8-0.9 band pileup, 0.9-1.0 shortfall). Expected: CC ceiling rises -> 0.9-1.0 band fills, but volume over-generates (mean CF already matched), so this is step 1 of an availability-basis retune, NOT a keeper.
